liveArticlesUntouched.claim: None of the 18 currently-published demo articles is read, rewritten, unpublished or re-slugged by this proposal.
enforcedBy: Membership: every batch is drawn only from rows the audit marked MISSING (never published on the demo). The 18 live ones are CHANGED (7) or NEW_ON_DEMO (11) and are structurally not in that set.
Slug collision check: no candidate slug equals any live slug (checked below); an import at a candidate slug therefore cannot overwrite a live post.
Draft-only: the import step creates drafts, so even a mistaken match could not replace a live published article without a separate, human publish.

bodyAvailability.method: content:encoded from the verified WXR, stripped of comments, script/style, shortcodes and tags; classified on the surviving prose word count
